question:
The line chart given below shows the number of girls in 7 schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b79ac7005ed4cc28ecc61dfe789749cfc139d3eeaad717dc793839eadac7236f.png] 

Number of girls in S1 is how much percent less than the number of girls in S2?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of girls in S1 = 400

Number of girls in S2 = 1000

Number of girls in S1 less than the number of girls in S2 = 1000 - 400

⇒ 600

Percentage of number of girls in S1 is how much less than the number of

girls in S2 = 600/1000 × 100

⇒ 60 percent

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
